name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
purpose: Post-trained open weights of the Qwen3.5 generation; a hosted version (Qwen3.5-Flash) runs on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. The card states no target-user sentence.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read: Apache License 2.0 with the vendor copyright appendix ('Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud'), no additional terms.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE, vision encoder
architecture.attention: 10 x (3 Gated DeltaNet + 1 gated attention), hidden 2048
architecture.why_this_design: Card: 'Efficient Hybrid Architecture: Gated Delta Networks combined with sparse Mixture-of-Experts deliver high-throughput inference with minimal latency and cost overhead.'

variants.notes: size from research/52-purpose-models.md; mmproj 1.79 GB extra

pc-16gb.variant: Q4_K_M 22 GB, experts partly in RAM

mac-16-24gb.notes: The 22 GB file does not fit 16 GB.

engine_support.notes: Tona has ArchId::Qwen35Moe (engine/model/arch.h; Ornith family); this checkpoint not measured by us.

strengths: Broadest language claim of the open generalists (201 languages and dialects)
Knowledge, long-context, multilingual and search numbers all on one card
3 B active parameters: fast decode on Tona's machinery
weaknesses: Vendor numbers only; no independent factuality score collected
Thinking on by default; the card recommends 32K output tokens, 81,920 for hard tasks
soft.behavior: Thinking on by default (<think>); enable_thinking=false for direct answers; no /think or /nothink soft switch. Sampling T=1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5; keep thinking out of the history.
best_for: General chat and research assistant on the reference machine
avoid_for: Hard factual recall without a search tool
soft.maturity: Qwen: large community, direct predecessor of Tona's coder family.

tona_fit.reason: Strongest published knowledge and multilingual numbers among the 35B-A3B class, Apache-2.0 (text read), 22 GB Q4_K_M fits 16 GB VRAM plus RAM, and the architecture (qwen35moe) is already in Tona; no independent German score exists for this exact model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B has one: MMLU-ProX DE 80.0).
blockers: no Tona measurement on the reference box yet

sources.note: General purpose section: GGUF size, recommendation

open_questions: Our own decode and prefill rate on gfx1200
Whether Qwen3.6-35B-A3B should replace it as the general default (see its record)
